info.title: url2llm API draft
info.description: Draft scrape request and response contract with simple JPEG screenshots. Not implemented by the current backend. No server is configured and requests must not be sent to the existing API.

post.description: Draft contract. Select outputs with formats, shared browser settings with sharedParams, and optional output-specific settings. Caching is off by default. No branding output or provider-routing diagnostics.

200.description: Validated requested outputs. Partial success is possible only when explicitly requested; see is_partial and output_errors. Example credit values are illustrative, not a price quote.

screenshot.message: The requested screenshot was not produced.

502.description: Requested content or outputs could not be produced.

BearerAuth.description: url2llm API key with scrape scope.

quality.description: JPEG/WebP quality; defaults to 80. Omit for PNG.

ScrapeScreenshotParams.description: Viewport or full-page screenshot. Base64 delivery returns an image data URL without waiting for storage. URL delivery uploads first and returns a public URL on the image domain. Viewport dimensions belong in sharedParams.viewport.

country.description: Supported ISO country for network egress; omission does not imply a country or change languages.

viewport.description: Shared viewport for navigation and screenshots; omit for desktop 1920x1080 or mobile 412x915.

renderJs.description: Render with JavaScript by default. False selects the explicit HTTP path.

mobile.description: Mobile viewport, touch and user-agent emulation; does not request a mobile carrier IP.

blockAds.description: Existing resource filtering; separate from accepting cookie banners or dismissing popups.

languages.description: Ordered BCP 47 language preferences, independent of country. Validate actual tags at runtime.

ScrapeRequest.title: url2llm proposed scrape request
ScrapeRequest.description: Draft scrape request with shared browser settings and output-specific options. Not the live endpoint schema.

AssetMetadata.description: What is known about one asset beyond its URL. Keys differ by asset_type.

provider.description: Videos only: html5, youtube or vimeo
provider.title: Provider

AssetMetadata.title: AssetMetadata

BrandAsset.description: One image or video the page references, as produced by render.assets.

filename.description: Derived from the title or alt text
filename.title: Filename

BrandAsset.title: BrandAsset

Link.description: One anchor on the page, as produced by render.links.
Link.title: Link

credits_used.description: Credits this request charged. Zero on a re-read or an unbilled failure
credits_used.title: Credits Used

ScrapeResult.description: Requested outputs only. In fail mode every requested output must validate. In return-partial mode return successful outputs and errors for failed outputs; if none succeed return an error response. Partial billing remains an activation gate.

screenshot.description: URL of the JPEG screenshot. Artifact access and retention must be finalized before activation.

profile.description: Present for new and existing profile requests; reuse id as sharedParams.profile.profileId. Omitted when no profile is requested.

is_partial.description: True only when at least one requested output succeeded and at least one failed in return-partial mode.
